title: C2 · The price of a forecast
description: Прочитайте текст и дайте четыре коротких ответа.
instructions: Answer in English using words from the text or recording.

sections.title: The price of a forecast
sections.body: A forecast that prompts successful prevention may appear mistaken precisely because people acted on it. One proposed solution is to score the forecast against a simulated world without intervention. This restores comparability at a price: errors in the simulation can masquerade as errors in the forecast. Publishing several simulations exposes sensitivity to assumptions, but agreement among them carries little weight if they share the same omissions. Independent variation in their assumptions is thus more informative than sheer numerical agreement.

sections.title: Preserving an absence
